newsitem.title: CHINA: China to ship 3.0 mln tonnes of corn to south.
newsitem.headline: China to ship 3.0 mln tonnes of corn to south.

text.p: China has decided to ship three million tonnes of corn from northeastern producing regions to the high-consuming south, the third time in six months, official media said on Sunday.

The corn would be shipped from northeastern Heilongjiang, Jilin and Liaoning provinces and the Inner Mongolia region, the official Grain and Oil Market Daily said in an edition seen in Beijng on Sunday.
The State Council, or cabinet, has ordered the corn shipment to southern areas to ease pressure on stocks in producing provinces, it said.
China's northeastern provinces reported two consecutive bumper corn harvests in 1995 and in 1996, creating storage difficulties for state granaries, state media has said.
The provinces shipped two million tonnes of corn to southern regions in late 1996 and a further 1.5 million tonnes were now being moved, state media has reported.
